scope: Newest-first ME5: both Misty's Vitality prints, complete attachment/shuffle then turn end. Artwork and true BREAK excluded.

ruleReferences.facts: Misty Supporter: up to4 Basic Water Energy from own deck to one own Pokemon, shuffle; using the card ends own turn. Inline Water icon is omitted by page text extraction; local bilingual card text and official FAQ identify Basic Water.
Direct official Misty FAQ: turn still ends when zero Basic Water Energy are selected.

B-03 Supporter declaration conditions/no-effect legality; H hidden deck search and D-04/D-05 selections. Preserve existing rejection for actually empty deck; allowing fail-to-find in a nonempty hidden deck is distinct. Empty-deck application is an inference from general rules, not a card-specific FAQ.

evidence.textEn: Search your deck for up to 4 Basic <sprite name="water" tint=1> Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.
evidence.textZh: 如果使用了这张卡牌的话，则自己的回合结束。选择自己牌库中最多4张「基本<sprite name="water" tint=1>能量」，附着于自己的1只宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。
